scope: Read-only Arcade Three-Domain transition ledgers bound into the existing Paper-Boat Return D.U.T. as a 3-port by 4-channel joint view and fully returned to the existing A0 Science Desk.
six_step_binding: Arcade app.js publishes its existing threedomain:render detail through a read-only request/record session channel.
The shared adapter validates and normalizes Chemistry, Life and Physics ledgers without stepping or mutating a model.
The Paper-Boat D.U.T. renders three distinct source ports with C00, C01, C10 and C11 weighted fibres.
The same frozen 3x4 record rotates with the declared Paper-Boat projection while counts and marginals remain invariant.
Object-space ledger fields remain separate from screen-space path position and line projection.
At classification the 720-degree checkpoint compares the complete canonical 3x4 fingerprint to the stage-1 capture.

transition_contract.C00: 0->0 inactive retention; grey; observed zero-state channel, not NULL
transition_contract.marginals: source and target zero/one counts are recomputed and checked
transition_contract.joint: arithmetic centroid of the three existing ledger phasors

carrier_mask_contract.exact_count_only: 5+6=11 is a shell count, not a coupling operator or 11x11 identity

transport.policy: source publishes, sink requests and freezes; no command or feedback message exists

contents: open visual and independent human acceptance gate

Shared Science Desk is under continuing cross-thread documentary return; this receipt freezes only its scoped section anchor.

claim_boundary: This is a deterministic source-bound interface and projection check. The session binding does not identify the three domain models, infer a common mechanism, establish a physical topology, equate D5 with D6 or convert shell counts into grid/carrier identity.
